title: Analysis code: LLM-assisted linguistic review of textbooks (randomized controlled study)
description: Python code that reproduces the tables and figures of the paper "Large Language Model-Assisted Linguistic Review in a Governmental Textbook Approval Process: A Randomized Controlled Study" from the published response logs and reference standard. Includes automated checks against the numbers reported in the paper.
